subject: Post-call: BrightPay embedding -> reranker timeout repro & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@brightpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 17:15:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: BrightPay embedding -> reranker timeout repro & next steps

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan: 

- Symptom: Intermittent 502/504 when calling the reranker after a batch of embeddings. You noted this happens under burst load (~200 concurrent requests) and usually within the first 30s of a workload spike.
- Hypothesis: routing + timeout interplay between the embeddings consumer and the reranker model variant (v2-q8). Could be a cold-start on reranker or transient upstream queueing.
- Items we asked you to share: minimal repro (Postman or curl), sdk install logs, a recent request id from a failing attempt.

Attachments: brightpay-postman-collection.json (collection with a minimal repro flow), sdk_install_log.txt (installer output from your node hosts).

Next steps I propose:
1) If you can run the Postman collection with the included delay settings we attached, capture one failing request id and paste it to this thread (or drop logs).
2) Monica will propose triage steps (config tweaks + quick mitigations) we can try on your side (client retry/backoff, increase client timeout to 45s, avoid synchronous large-batch rerank for spikes).
3) If repro persists, schedule a 1h deep-dive with our SRE and your infra team (we can bring traffic traces).

If that works, confirm availability for a deep-dive window early next week (EET preferred). Thanks — happy to coordinate.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: brightpay-postman-collection.json (application/json) - 18KB]
[Attachment: sdk_install_log.txt (text/plain) - 9KB]

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@brightpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightPay Platform <eng@brightpay.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 08:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightPay embedding -> reranker timeout repro & next steps

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear plan. I ran the Postman collection against our staging environment this morning and reproduced a failing rerank call. Details: 

- Repro steps (summary): send 50-user-batch embeddings -> call reranker endpoint (/v1/models/reranker-v2/score) with payload of 50 candidates per query.
- Observed: reranker returns 504 Gateway Timeout occasionally (approx 1 in 8 runs).
- Culprit request id from our gateway: brp-req-20261206-77a4c.
- Error snippet from our edge: "upstream read timeout after 30000ms".

I've attached the raw request/response for brp-req-20261206-77a4c (brightpay-repro.json). We're running the Redwood SDK v0.9.3 (Node) with default timeouts.

For now we've increased the client timeout to 40s which reduces failures but doesn't eliminate them. Happy to join a deep-dive. EET afternoon (14:00-17:00) Tue/Wed works.

—Liam
Liam O'Neill | Engineering Manager, BrightPay
[Attachment: brightpay-repro.json (application/json) - 24KB]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@brightpay.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightPay embedding -> reranker timeout repro & next steps

Thanks for the repro and the request id, Liam — that'll help a lot. Quick triage notes from our side before the deep-dive: 

1) Client-side mitigations (fast to try):
   - Increase client timeout to 60s for the reranker call only; keep embeddings shorter timeouts.
   - Add exponential backoff + jitter on 5xx/504 responses (initial backoff 200ms, max 5s, 3 retries).
   - For high concurrency bursts, throttle to concurrency=50 and use queueing to smooth peaks.

2) Server-side checks we'll run if you share the failing request id(s):
   - Check routing logs to see whether the request hit a warm reranker instance or caused a cold-start.
   - Inspect the kernel/quantization path for v2-q8 under the specific sequence length you used (you said ~2.4k tokens total).

3) Triage commands / how you can help capture more signal:
   - If you can reproduce, include the X-Request-ID header in your client call (we recommend X-Request-ID: brp-<local>-<ts>). Sample curl below: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDWOOD_KEY>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "X-Request-ID: brp-req-local-$(date +%s)" 
  -d @brightpay-repro.json 

I've attached a tiny helper (trace-request-template.txt) that formats the headers we need. Also, please keep rdw-trace-ids (we'll correlate to our traces).

We'll look up brp-req-20261206-77a4c in our traces tonight and report back tomorrow. If it's a cold-start we'll propose a short-term routing change and a longer-term model pool tuning.

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: trace-request-template.txt (text/plain) - 1KB]

From: BrightPay Platform <eng@brightpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightPay embedding -> reranker timeout repro & next steps

Monica / team — attaching the logs you asked for from our staging gateway. The zip includes nginx access logs and the service logs for the worker that initiated the reranker call. 

Observed in the logs for brp-req-20261206-77a4c: repeated upstream read timeouts to r-prd-reranker-eu-2, processes were showing queue length spikes and a few instances with ~0% CPU for short periods (we assume they got stalled).

Attached: rdw-trace-logs.zip (contains logs + a tiny heap snapshot). We'll keep running the Postman collection with X-Request-ID per your curl template and will paste new request ids as we get them.

Forwarding the minimal heap snapshot here because one of our infra folks thinks there might be momentary IO stalls on the host that correlate with the timeouts.

—BrightPay Platform
[Attachment: rdw-trace-logs.zip (application/zip) - 1.1MB]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@brightpay.com>, BrightPay Platform <eng@brightpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightPay embedding -> reranker timeout repro & next steps

Thanks everyone — good data and thanks for the heap snapshot, that was useful. Quick plan and next steps: 

- We've opened SUP-4321 and attached the logs you shared to the ticket. Monica will own the initial triage and I'll coordinate scheduling.
- Short-term mitigations for BrightPay to try today:
   1) Set reranker call timeout = 60s (client).
   2) Apply retry with exponential backoff (3x) for 502/504/5xx.
   3) If possible, limit burst concurrency to <= 50 while we tune model pools.
- Redwood action items:
   1) Monica to look up our internal trace for brp-req-20261206-77a4c and post findings in SUP-4321 (including whether the request hit a cold or warm instance).
   2) Evelyn to propose a short-term routing policy that biases rerank traffic to warm pools in eu region for customers with heavy bursts.

I'll schedule the deep-dive for Tue 2026-12-09 15:00 EET (invite incoming). Please add any additional failing request ids to the Jira ticket or reply here with the X-Request-ID header so we can correlate.

Thanks — and we'll aim to have a concrete mitigation (client + server) inside 48 hours after the deep-dive.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
